Note: Insert code block is ctrl + alt + i

Load libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
```

Load dataset, clean column names, convert to appropriate data types, set strings to lowercase

```{r}
df <- read.csv("DATA2X02_2026_2_survey_clean.csv")
glimpse(df)


# CLEAN COLUMN NAMES
df_clean_names <- clean_names(df)
summary(df_clean_names)

# REMOVE THE FIRST COLUMN (FULL RESPONSE)
df_short <- df_clean_names[, -1]
summary(df_short)
colnames(df_short) <- c("age_years",
                        "height_cm",
                        "intl_dom_type",
                        "2X02_type",
                        "1X01_grade",
                        "2X02_grade",
                        "assessment_workflow",
                        "travel_to_campus_min",
                        "rent_y_n",
                        "rent_dollars",
                        "employment_hours",
                        "sleep_hours",
                        "music_type",
                        "aliens_y_n",
                        "water_l",
                        "languages_number",
                        "learning_pathway_n",
                        "learning_pathway_why",
                        "rev_lec_n",
                        "rev_lec_why",
                        "multitask_y_n",
                        "multitask_n",
                        "multitask_why")

# FACTOR CATEGORICAL VARIABLES
df_short <- df_short %>% 
  mutate(across(c("intl_dom_type", 
                  "2X02_type",
                  "1X01_grade",
                  "2X02_grade",
                  "assessment_workflow",
                  "rent_y_n",
                  "music_type",
                  "aliens_y_n",
                  "languages_number",
                  "learning_pathway_n",
                  "rev_lec_n",
                  "multitask_y_n"), as.factor))

# CHANGE RELEVANT CATEGORICAL VARIABLES TO ORDINAL
df_short <- df_short %>% 
  mutate(across(c("1X01_grade", "2X02_grade"), 
                ~ factor(.x, 
                         levels = c("P", "CR", "D", "HD"), 
                         ordered = TRUE)))

# NOTE 1: I think assessment workflow should also be an ordinal variable but I'm not sure where to put "Other". Also should "immediately" and "gradually" be on the same level? 


# EMPLOYMENT STATUS
employment_y_n <- as.factor(ifelse(df_short$employment_hours > 0, "yes", "no"))
df_short <- add_column(df_short, 
                       employment_y_n = employment_y_n, 
                       .before = "employment_hours")

# SET ALL STRINGS TO LOWERCASE
df_short <- df_short %>% 
    mutate(learning_pathway_why = str_to_lower(learning_pathway_why)) %>%
    mutate(multitask_why = str_to_lower(multitask_why))

```
